title: Trino execution limits are client-enforced; keep docs and tests in sync
answers: Where are Trino build deadlines enforced
How does Trino model build cancellation work
body:
Trino build deadlines (15 min for builds, 5 min for alias passes) are enforced by the client, which cancels the active Trino cursor on expiry or activity cancellation; no server session property is used.
When changing statement sequence in trino_materialization.py or trino_model_aliases.py, also update:
- products/managed_warehouse/backend/tests/test_trino_materialization.py (execute.call_args_list indexes, fetchall.side_effect lists)
- products/managed_warehouse/backend/tests/test_trino_model_aliases.py (fetchall.side_effect; there is an assertion that cursor.execute is not called on the happy path)
- docs/internal/hogql-trino-compiler.md (execution-limit section)
